Class GameLoop

java.lang.Object
javafx.animation.AnimationTimer
gamemode.gym.core.GameLoop
public class GameLoop extends javafx.animation.AnimationTimer
The GameLoop class represents the main game update loop for the gym rhythm mini-game.

This class extends AnimationTimer and is responsible for running the real-time game logic on every frame. It handles note spawning, note movement updates, score penalties for missed notes, combo resets, and visual effects.

The loop continuously performs the following operations:

  • Updates UI animations (such as fading the judgment line)
  • Spawns new notes at fixed time intervals
  • Updates existing notes through the NoteManager
  • Applies penalties when notes are missed
  • Triggers visual miss effects

This class acts as the central controller connecting UI, note logic, score tracking, combo management, and visual effects.
